# KeyKeeper 0.3.7
## 中文
- 可选 iCloud 同步：在你的 Mac 之间同步加密的密钥、名称、字段和备注，每台 Mac 单独批准调用方。默认关闭；历史缺值记录保留，不会用缺值覆盖另一台已有的值。 - 升级到新的受保护存储。首次从旧公开版升级时，请按引导确认本机迁移；原数据保留，调用方需要重新授权。全新安装使用独立的本机准备流程，同步由你另行开启。 - 同步暂时暂停后会自动恢复；修复启动时读取状态失败后，重试错误关闭同步，以及关闭后旧请求又重新开启的竞态。 - 重做欢迎引导、添加与编辑、详情、设置、网站登录态、使用权限和访问记录页面。支持 Codex／Claude Code 插件选择，自动生成的 ID 和环境变量与手填名称分开，授权详情可下钻。 - 修复 CLI 在 worktree 构建中版本显示 unknown，以及设置页误报已是最新的问题；优化中英文、窄分栏、输入框、过期提示和隐藏值预览。
**升级提示：** 从旧版迁移时可能出现 macOS 钥匙串授权，请核对请求来自 KeyKeeper。iCloud 同步需要同一 Apple 账号；网页登录态和调用方授权不会随云端同步。
## English
- Optional iCloud sync for encrypted keys and metadata across your Macs. Each Mac approves its own callers. Sync is off by default; missing-value records are retained without overwriting values present on another Mac. - Protected local storage with an explicit migration flow for older installs. Original data is retained and callers require fresh approval. New installs have a separate local setup flow; enabling sync remains your choice. - Automatic recovery after temporary sync interruptions. Fix retry incorrectly disabling sync at startup and a stale request re-enabling sync after it was turned off. - Redesigned onboarding, add/edit, details, settings, website sessions, permissions and access history. Choose Codex or Claude Code setup, distinguish generated IDs from names you enter, and inspect authorization details. - Correct CLI build versions in Git worktrees and unknown-version install status; improve localization, narrow split views, text fields, expiry indicators and masked value previews.
**Upgrading:** Confirm the local migration when prompted. macOS may ask for Keychain access from KeyKeeper. iCloud sync requires the same Apple account; website sessions and caller approvals remain local.

# KeyKeeper 0.3.6
适用于 Apple Silicon Mac，macOS 14 或更新版本。
- **更新更及时**：运行时默认每 6 小时检查一次，签名更新在后台下载、退出时安装；一直不退出时，一天后会提醒。已保存的更新选择保持不变。 - **下载与安装说清楚**：设置开关改为“在后台下载更新”。关闭后依旧检查更新，但下载前会询问；不会为了安装更新突然中断当前工作。 - **Agent 调用更容易排错**：`keykeeper run --env` 支持精确映射变量名，`--plan` 可以预检映射与本地值是否存在，不读取密钥值、不启动目标命令。子命令失败时能分清是否已经完成注入。 - **首次使用与授权更清楚**：完善 Agent 的首次使用指引，并简化授权窗信息层次。 - **发布更可靠**：同时验证更新源与安装包的签名，核对线上文件的实际摘要；发布中断可安全续发，不覆盖已有不同版本，也不再把网络故障当作“版本不存在”。
更新依赖 KeyKeeper 正在运行和网络可用，不是实时推送。自动下载不等于立即安装；想马上更新，可以在设置里选择“检查更新…”。
---
For Apple Silicon Macs, macOS 14 or later.
- While running, KeyKeeper checks every six hours by default, downloads signed updates in the background and installs on quit. Long-running sessions get a reminder after a day. Explicit saved preferences are preserved. - Settings now says “Download updates in the background,” distinguishing download from installation. Turning it off keeps checks and asks before downloading. - `keykeeper run --env` maps fields to exact client variable names; `--plan` previews mappings and local presence without reading secret values or launching the child. Failure diagnostics distinguish successful injection from a failed child command. - Clearer first-use guidance for agents and a simpler approval window. - Release delivery validates both signatures and actual remote bytes. Interrupted releases resume without overwriting different assets or treating an unavailable service as an absent release.
Checks require the app to be running and a working connection; this is not push delivery. Use “Check for Updates…” to update sooner.

# KeyKeeper 0.3.5
适用于 Apple Silicon Mac，macOS 14 或更新版本。
- **导入项目的 .env**：`keykeeper import ./.env --id my-app`。App 展示变量名，批准后全部值进入钥匙串，Agent 只收到结果；通过 `keykeeper run` 注入使用。原文件不删除，先验证项目跑通再自行清理。 - **113 个服务商模板**：按品牌、地区、套餐和凭据类型整理，支持搜索、分类、图标、有效期说明和官方后台跳转；新增凭据时可选模板。 - **Codex / Claude Code 双插件**：随 App 附带，设置里有安装指引；安装插件不等于授予密钥权限。 - **记录和权限可点开查看**：访问记录与名称/备注变更分开，详情展示调用方、授权范围和期限，历史结果不再冒充当前权限。 - **界面修复**：批准后刷新当前状态，展开/收起授权窗不再破坏边角；已有网站登录态也能继续选择 Chrome 导入或在 KeyKeeper 内登录。 - **浏览器导入可恢复**：CLI、接收页与 App 共用同一个提案状态。粘贴后即使错过弹窗或重启 App，也能在 10 分钟内从菜单面板继续审核，或用 `keykeeper proposal status/open` 查询和重新打开，不必再次复制密钥。 - **防止存错内容**：浏览器导入在写入前复核目标状态，终态会清除暂存值；字段可以持久保存“拒绝 URL”及公开前后缀规则，后续恢复和替换继续执行同一校验。 - **不再丢失待批准请求**：活跃请求会留在菜单面板中等待处理，历史决定与当前待办保持分离。
导入边界：仅支持单行赋值；保留引号中的转义内容，不执行变量/命令展开。格式不完整或多行值会拒绝整份导入；空值、保留变量和无法还原的变量名会列为跳过。所有导入值默认保密，不根据名字猜测可公开性。请先核对跳过项并验证项目，再删除原文件；导入不能撤回过去的泄漏。
许可证：App、CLI 与 Core 从本版起使用 FSL-1.1-MIT，两年后自动转为 MIT；SDK、skill 与插件继续使用 MIT，旧版本许可证不变。
---
For Apple Silicon Macs, macOS 14 or later.
- Import project dotenv files with native approval. Every imported value stays in the Keychain, credentials are inject-only, and the original file is retained. - 113 provider templates with searchable brands/categories, region/plan distinctions, icons, expiry guidance and official console links. - Bundled Codex and Claude Code plugins with setup instructions; installing a plugin grants no key access. - Separate access/change histories and drill-down permission details. Historical decisions and current authorization are shown separately. - Fix approval refresh, expanding/collapsing prompt corners, and missing Chrome import options after adding a website session. - Browser imports now share one metadata-only proposal state across the CLI, receiver and App. After paste, a proposal remains recoverable for ten minutes, survives an App restart, and can be reviewed or cancelled from the menu panel without copying the secret again. - Import commits re-check their target before writing and scrub held candidates at terminal states. Persistent URL rejection and public prefix/suffix rules protect later restores and replacements too. - Live approval requests remain actionable in the menu panel when their original window is missed.
Import supports single-line assignments only, with quotes and escapes but no shell interpolation. Malformed/multiline input fails closed; empty, reserved or unsupported names are skipped. Validate your project and skipped variables before removing the original. Import does not undo previous exposure.
License: starting with this release, the app, CLI and core use FSL-1.1-MIT and convert to MIT after two years. The SDKs, skill and plugins remain MIT; earlier releases are unchanged.
